request: Analyze GSE157712 for PMID 34784301 (Muscle fibrosis and maladaptation occur progressively in CKD and are rescued by dialysis.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq, human vastus lateralis biopsies (S4.6.1.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Difference in muscle gene expression between non-dialysis CKD patients and healthy age-matched controls (disease state, associational); secondary: CKD pre- vs post-dialysis initiation. No exercise intervention or exercise arm exists; both groups were 'highly sedentary' (S2.1.p1).
final.sample_inclusion: 7 CKD, 7 control (S2.5.p1); 4 dialysis samples, 3 paired with prior CKD biopsy, 1 unpaired (S2.6.p3)
final.repeated_measure_unit: patient (sample ID used as blocking variable for paired CKD/dialysis, S4.6.2.p2)
planned_contrasts: CKD vs Control (S2.5.p1; paper: 967 DEGs, 464 up / 503 down, q < 0.05)
Dialysis vs CKD pre-dialysis (S2.6.p3; paper: 0 DEGs, q < 0.05)
final.paper_method: edgeR TMM + limma-voom, CPM > 0.5 in >= 7 samples, patient as blocking variable, eBayes, BH q < 0.05 (S4.6.2.p2)
final.exercise_content: Exercise mentioned only as background (S2.3.p1, S3.p8 citing other studies); physical function tests (strength, endurance) are outcomes, not interventions.

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S4.6.2.p2 lists exactly two DE contrasts: CKD vs healthy controls and CKD pre- vs post-dialysis. Neither is an exercise contrast. The paper studies kidney disease and dialysis effects on muscle.

final.checks: S4.6.1.p1 names GSE157712; GEO samples are vastus lateralis Control 7 / CKD 7 / Dialysis 4, matching S2.5.p1 and S2.6.p3 (3 dialysis subjects 10,14,15 also have CKD samples; subject 13 unpaired).

ownership.reasoning: Accession cited in the paper's data availability; group sizes match exactly.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (C1, S15, ...) appear in brackets in the GEO title; inspect matched 18/18. Group taken from title prefix (equals characteristics group).

final.source: GEO data_processing: STAR + RSEM v1.3.0, 'raw counts (generated using RSEM)'

matrix.reasoning: Integer fraction 0.93 with non-integer values; data_processing states RSEM expected counts. Count-scale, consistent with the paper's voom route.

design.subject: subject
design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the only factor is disease state (Control / CKD / Dialysis). The paper's planned contrasts are CKD vs Control and Dialysis vs CKD (S4.6.2.p2); no sample received an exercise intervention and both groups were sedentary (S2.1.p1). An exercise estimand cannot be identified from these data.

candidates.reason_rejected: Disease-state comparison, not exercise; answering it would not address the requested exercise question.

candidates.value: grp Dialysis vs CKD (paired by subject)
candidates.reason_rejected: Treatment is dialysis initiation, not exercise.

design.reasoning: Request asks how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends; the paper has no exercise comparison, so the case is refused at design.
